scenario: Buying a snack and a ready meal at a convenience store: ask for a shopping bag, request chopsticks, ask staff to heat food, ask whether card payment is possible, locate an item, and ask whether a smaller size is available. Each question should make the requested item or service explicit. Use distinct tasks, and make the last permission or availability question the hard comment bonus.
audience: English-speaking adults learning practical beginner Korean
level: Beginner: progress from short polite requests to location and availability questions; two easy, two medium, two hard
